about: Hazard map settings (exotic objects design 3.8, package XO18). Where a hazard turns harsh and deadly, and the stated stock ship used when no ship is chosen. Policy figures, not physics: each says where it comes from, and a pack or the GM may change them.

dose.harsh_src: ICRP Publication 103 (2007), the most a radiation worker may take in any one year, 50 mSv: a day's stay (or one pass) giving that is harsh
dose.deadly_src: about 1 Sv brings on acute radiation sickness (IAEA, Diagnosis and Treatment of Radiation Injuries, Safety Reports Series 2, 1998): a day's stay (or one pass) giving that is deadly

margin_src: chosen: a hull above three quarters of the temperature it can take, or a climb out needing more than three quarters of the fuel, reads harsh

stock_ship.name: stock ship
stock_ship.src: stated stand-in (design 3.8, open point 13): 10 km/s left in the tanks, a 10 g/cm² aluminium hull, as dark as it is bright in the heat
